observation: Pixel Adreno 640 monolithic lighting kernel produced zeros; smaller workgroups also failed. Separate shadow dispatch restored valid rendering.
cause: Not established; resource pressure or driver compilation are hypotheses.
reproduce: Build the saved native probe against the same pinned Android ARM64 package, and run either saved shader with camera.scene.bin, pathtrace.output.bin, pathtrace.scene.bin, lights.scene.bin; dispatch 1728 groups at 64 or 3456 at 32.
currentFix: main followed by shadow_resolve, with a GPU storage buffer and separate compute passes; no CPU shadow traversal or per-path readback.
